drift_summary: A definitive claim of a 12% soybean yield increase across all field sites was significantly hedged and narrowed in the published version, becoming a conditional statement about potential increases under specific soil conditions with acknowledged site variability.

claim_diffs.preprint_text: The seed treatment increased soybean yield by 12% across all field sites.
claim_diffs.published_text: The seed treatment may increase soybean yield under selected soil conditions, although effects varied across sites.
claim_diffs.change_description: The strong, quantitative claim of a 12% yield increase across all sites was significantly hedged and narrowed to a potential increase under selected soil conditions, with acknowledged variability across sites, transforming a definitive statement into a more cautious and conditional one.
